## Architecture Guidance Metadata

```yaml
guidance_id: 'GUID-SEC-SECOPS-ABB-MATRIX-2.1.08'
guidance_name: 'Security Operations ABB Alignment Matrix'
guidance_type: 'abb-catalog'
adm_phase: 'Phase B-D'
category: 'security'
version: '0.1.0'
status: 'draft'
applicability: 'enterprise'
tags: ['security', 'secops', 'abb-catalog', 'traceability', 'phase-b', 'phase-c', 'phase-d']
author: 'Jesse Adams, assisted by AI'
```

---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase B–D**: This matrix is the traceability reference for all Architecture Building Blocks (ABBs) defined within the Security Operations domain. Each row maps an ABB to its parent L2 capability, TOGAF phase, and paired Reference Architecture Document (RAD).
>
> **ABBs are solution- and vendor-agnostic.** They define *what* architectural capability must exist, not *how* it is implemented. Solution Building Blocks (SBBs) are defined in Phase E–F and are not recorded here.
